run_dequantize_4bit: run dequantize_4bit kernel to convert 4bit quantized tensors back to full precision on XPU
run_dequantize_blockwise: run dequantize_blockwise kernel to dequantize blockwise quantized tensors on XPU
run_gemv_4bit: run gemv_4bit kernel to perform 4bit matrix-vector multiplication on XPU
run_int8_linear_matmul: run int8_linear_matmul kernel to perform int8 matrix multiplication on XPU
run_quantize_blockwise: run quantize_blockwise kernel to quantize tensors blockwise on XPU
